title: progress on long forms
rule: On long forms, show a clear progress indicator of how much is done and how much remains.

citation.source: NN/g — 4 Principles to Reduce Cognitive Load in Forms

pass_when: Long form shows done vs remaining progress.
fail_when: Long form has no progress indication.
overview: Long form shows done vs remaining progress.
not_when: Not for single form on one screen.
agent_hint: On long forms, show a clear progress indicator of how much is done and how much remains.
description: On long forms, show a clear progress indicator of how much is done and how much remains. Long form shows done vs remaining progress. It fails when Long form has no progress indication.
